name: Luz
source:
A mysterious fashionista.
Always dressed to the nines and is never seen without a heavy armor of makeup. Loves poking others' buttons, especially Kie's.

She can be quite manipulative and cunning, and isn't afraid of using her words or appearance to get her way.

Who is Luz, really?

[From [url=https://meiri.itch.io/doce-fim]official profile[/url]]
